title: opencode-cross-review options
description: OpenCode v2 plugin options for directed driver-model to reviewer-model routing. The plugin mirrors these rules in code; unknown fields are rejected.

enabled.description: When false the plugin registers no hooks at all.

driver.description: Agent ID that must be the current root session's agent.

reviewer.description: Subagent agent ID whose model is routed.

mappings.description: Directed model mappings. Many drivers may share one reviewer; one driver may map to only one reviewer.

driver.description: Driver model reference: providerID/modelID or providerID/modelID#variant.

reviewer.description: Reviewer model reference: providerID/modelID or providerID/modelID#variant.
